collection.title: Bentley Bentayga 2015 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Bentley Bentayga 2015 - 2020 model which requires a 27" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
